extracted.intended_audience: news media professionals and visual communicators; students and educators interested in visual journalism; potential SND members and partner organizations
extracted.subtask_description: Organizational 'About Us' page describing the Society for News Design's mission, values, leadership model, student chapter activities, diversity and inclusion commitment, and opportunities to get involved or partner.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enhancing communication through excellence in visual journalism
rubrics_metrics.description: Enhancing communication around the world through excellence in visual journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SND's stated mission/goal: to enhance communication by promoting excellence in visual journalism and design across print, web, and mobile publications and products. This frames the organization's standards and activities around high-quality visual storytelling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope of professional practice / member roles
rubrics_metrics.description: Our members art direct, design, edit, report, illustrate, make photos and video, visualize data and write code.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the kinds of professional work SND considers part of visual journalism (design, editing, reporting, illustration, photography, video, data visualization, coding). Implies inclusivity of multiple disciplines in assessing or representing excellence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education and student chapter engagement
rubrics_metrics.description: From the beginning, education has always been important to SND. Our student chapters bring students and educators together in a campus community where they can learn from industry leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Student chapter activities and supports: students can host events, receive travel grants to workshops, obtain scholarships, and receive discounts on membership and SND events. Emphasizes education, mentorship, and practical supports as organizational priorities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Volunteer leadership and industry involvement
rubrics_metrics.description: Leadership: SND is a volunteer-run organization with industry leaders dedicating their time and expertise to the advancement of visual storytelling around the world.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions SND's governance and programming as led by volunteer industry professionals; implies standards based on practitioner experience and peer-led initiatives.

rubrics_metrics.name: Commitment to diversity & inclusion
rubrics_metrics.description: Our members represent a range of experiences, backgrounds, platforms, geographical locations and points of view. It is important to SND that the voices of all our members are represented and celebrated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Affirms aspiration to create an organization where equality and inclusion are achievable and where all members have equal opportunity to learn, grow, and thrive. Emphasizes valuing differences and working to make inclusive representation a reality.

rubrics_metrics.name: Opportunities to get involved / partnerships
rubrics_metrics.description: Get involved: Be a part of shaping the future of SND. We have a range of opportunities to get involved with SND. Become a partner: Want to partner with SND? We look forward to working with organizations like us to build a better design community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Encourages volunteerism and organizational partnerships as means of advancing SND's mission; implies collaboration and community-building are key criteria for participation and contribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contactability and organizational transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact SND: Society for News Design director@snd.org
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a direct contact point for inquiries, membership, and partnership — an implicit standard of accessibility and openness to engagement.
